title: A BANK THAT USES TIME
paragraphs: People usually pay money when they need someone to repair a chair or teach them a new skill. However, residents of the town of Brookfield have another option. They can join a "time bank," a program in which people exchange help without using money. Members earn one time credit for every hour they spend helping someone. They can then use their credits to receive help from other members. The program aims to bring neighbors together by giving everyone an opportunity to contribute.

To join, residents complete a form describing the skills they can offer and the help they need. A coordinator uses this information to connect members. An hour of gardening earns the same credit as an hour of computer lessons, even if one of these services usually costs more. Members do not have to help the person who helped them. For example, someone who repairs a bicycle can use the credit to get cooking lessons from a different member.

When the program began, fewer people joined than the organizers had expected. At first, the organizers thought residents were too busy to take part. However, conversations with local people revealed a different problem: many believed they had nothing useful to offer. In response, the organizers held meetings where they gave examples of simple tasks, such as watering plants while a neighbor was away. More residents joined after they realized that professional training was not necessary.

One of the new members was sixteen-year-old Adam, who helped an older resident organize photographs on her phone. Later, he used his credits to receive help preparing for a job interview from another member, a retired manager. Adam had originally joined to gain practical experience, but he discovered an additional benefit. Before joining, he rarely spoke to the adults on his street. Now, he feels more comfortable asking them for advice, and several have asked him for help with their phones.

The time bank still faces difficulties. Some requests remain unanswered because nobody with the right skills is available. In addition, members sometimes cancel arrangements at the last minute, leaving others without the help they expected. The organizers are considering a reminder system, but they have not introduced it yet. Although the program cannot replace every paid service, they believe it offers something valuable: a chance for people to recognize abilities in themselves and in their neighbors.

reading_questions.stem: What do we learn about time credits in paragraph I?
options: Members receive them for helping other people.
Members buy them when they join the program.
Members can use them only for professional services.
Members receive them only from the people they have helped.
reading_questions.answer: i) Members receive them for helping other people.
reading_questions.evidence: Members earn one time credit for every hour they spend helping someone.
reading_questions.rubric: 8 points for option i; 0 for another option.
reading_questions.explanation_en: Credits are earned by giving help. They are not bought with money. The paragraph does not limit their use to professional services or to the same person.
reading_questions.explanation_he: הנקודות נצברות כשעוזרים לאחרים. אין כאן קנייה בכסף, הגבלה לשירות מקצועי או דרישה לקבל עזרה דווקא מאותו אדם.
distractors: הטקסט מציג חלופה לתשלום בכסף; אין רכישה של נקודות בהצטרפות.
המילה only מוסיפה הגבלה שאינה מופיעה בטקסט.
אפשר לקבל עזרה מחברים אחרים; אין דרישה לקבל אותה דווקא ממקבל העזרה.

reading_questions.stem: What is true about an hour of gardening and an hour of computer lessons?
options: Their usual prices must be the same.
They earn the same number of time credits.
They must be offered by the same member.
Their time credits depend on their usual prices.
reading_questions.answer: ii) They earn the same number of time credits.
reading_questions.evidence: An hour of gardening earns the same credit as an hour of computer lessons, even if one of these services usually costs more.
reading_questions.rubric: 7 points for option ii; 0 for another option.
reading_questions.explanation_en: Equal time earns equal credit, even when the usual prices differ. Neither equal prices nor one provider is required.
reading_questions.explanation_he: השווי כאן נקבע לפי משך העזרה. ההשוואה למחיר הרגיל נועדה דווקא להדגיש שהמחיר אינו קובע את מספר הנקודות.
distractors: same מתייחס לנקודות, ולא למחיר הרגיל.
אין דרישה שאותו חבר ייתן את שני השירותים.
זה היפוך של הכלל: משך השירות קובע, גם כשהמחירים הרגילים שונים.

reading_questions.answer: The skills residents can offer AND the help they need.
reading_questions.evidence: a form describing the skills they can offer and the help they need
reading_questions.rubric: 4 points for the skills they can offer; 4 for the help they need. Repeating the same detail earns at most 4. Order does not matter.
reading_questions.explanation_en: The reference includes both kinds of information on the form: what residents can offer and what they need. Giving only one is incomplete.
reading_questions.explanation_he: הצירוף this information מתייחס לשני פרטים בטופס: מה התושבים יכולים להציע ומה הם צריכים. שתי גרסאות של אותו פרט אינן שני פרטים.

reading_questions.stem: Why did many residents hesitate to join the program?
options: They thought they were too busy to take part.
They did not want to speak to the organizers.
They believed they had no useful skills to offer.
They preferred to pay for professional services.
reading_questions.answer: iii) They believed they had no useful skills to offer.
reading_questions.evidence: many believed they had nothing useful to offer
reading_questions.rubric: 8 points for option iii; 0 for another option.
reading_questions.explanation_en: Being too busy was the organizers' first explanation. Conversations revealed the actual problem: residents doubted that they had anything useful to offer.
reading_questions.explanation_he: חוסר זמן היה ההסבר הראשוני של המארגנים. אחרי However מופיעה הסיבה שהתגלתה בשיחות: התושבים חשבו שאין להם מה להציע.
distractors: זה מה שהמארגנים חשבו בתחילה, לפני שהתגלתה הסיבה האמיתית.
הטקסט מספר שהתקיימו שיחות, ואינו מציין הימנעות משיחה.
תשלום על שירותים מוזכר בתחילת הטקסט, אך אינו הסיבה לאי־ההצטרפות.

reading_questions.stem: Why did more residents join after the meetings?
reading_questions.prefix: They realized that they did not need
reading_questions.evidence: More residents joined after they realized that professional training was not necessary.
reading_questions.rubric: 8 points for professional training / professional qualifications or an equivalent idea. A general claim about having more time does not answer the question.
reading_questions.explanation_en: The examples showed that simple help was enough: professional training was not necessary. Watering plants is an example, not a new entry requirement.
reading_questions.explanation_he: ההכשרה המקצועית לא הייתה דרושה. השקיית עציצים היא דוגמה למשימה פשוטה, ולא תנאי חדש להצטרפות.

reading_questions.stem: Why did Adam originally join the time bank?
reading_questions.evidence: Adam had originally joined to gain practical experience
reading_questions.rubric: 8 points for gaining practical experience. Later benefits, such as feeling more comfortable with neighbors, are not the original motive.
reading_questions.explanation_en: Originally points to the reason he joined: practical experience. Help with a job interview and greater confidence appear later in the story.
reading_questions.explanation_he: המילה originally מכוונת למניע המקורי: ניסיון מעשי. העזרה בראיון העבודה והקשר עם השכנים הם פרטים אחרים, ולא המניע שנמסר.

reading_questions.evidence: he rarely spoke to the adults on his street. Now, he feels more comfortable asking them for advice
reading_questions.rubric: 8 points for the adults on his street / his adult neighbors. The retired manager alone or all members of the time bank is not the stated reference.
reading_questions.explanation_en: Them is plural and refers back to the adults on his street. The manager is one person; the organizers are not the group discussed here.
reading_questions.explanation_he: them חוזר למבוגרים ברחוב של אדם. המנהל הוא אדם יחיד, ואין כאן הפניה לכל חברי התוכנית.
accepted_groups: the adults on adam s street
the adult neighbors on his street
the adult neighbours on his street

reading_questions.stem: Why can the reminder system not help members yet?
reading_questions.evidence: The organizers are considering a reminder system, but they have not introduced it yet.
reading_questions.rubric: 7 points for stating that the system has not yet been introduced / is still only being considered. Do not accept that it was introduced and failed.
reading_questions.explanation_en: The system is being considered. The text gives no result because it has not been introduced yet.
reading_questions.explanation_he: שוקלים להפעיל את המערכת, אך עדיין לא הפעילו אותה. אין בטקסט תוצאה שמאפשרת לקבוע שהיא הצליחה או נכשלה.
accepted_groups: have not introduced the system yet
have not introduced the reminder system yet

reading_questions.stem: Which statement best expresses the main message of the article?
options: A time bank succeeds only when it attracts trained professionals.
A time bank allows communities to stop using paid services.
A time bank solves the problem of finding help for every member.
A time bank can connect neighbors even though it has limitations.
reading_questions.answer: iv) A time bank can connect neighbors even though it has limitations.
reading_questions.evidence: The program aims to bring neighbors together ... Although the program cannot replace every paid service ... a chance for people to recognize abilities
reading_questions.rubric: 8 points for option iv; 0 for another option.
reading_questions.explanation_en: The article describes useful connections and real limits. It does not claim that professionals are required, that money becomes unnecessary, or that every request is answered.
reading_questions.explanation_he: הרעיון המרכזי משלב את התרומה לקשר בין שכנים עם המגבלות שנשארו. תשובות מוחלטות מוחקות את ההסתייגויות שבטקסט.
distractors: הטקסט אומר שהכשרה מקצועית אינה דרושה.
cannot replace every paid service סותר את הטענה שאפשר לוותר על שירותים בתשלום.
חלק מבקשות העזרה נשארות ללא מענה; every יוצר הכללה שגויה.

definitions: advice that helps you decide what to do
something that happens because of an action or event
information showing that something is true
to examine something carefully to find out what happened
to suggest that something is a good choice
able to change to suit a new situation
able to be trusted to do what is expected
connected with the subject being discussed
on purpose rather than by accident
used to say that a situation is disappointing or unlucky
to use all of something so that none is left
to have a duty to deal with something
during the time before another event happens
